alice.support: Escalation from Parcelly — TS/browser SDK tool.call failing when nested union expects number[] but receives base64 string for TypedArray. Customer P1, billing spikes.
carla.support: Can you paste the exact wire payload + SDK version + env? Minimal repro helps.
alice.support: Customer payload (redacted):
```
{ "shipment_id":"sh_123", "status":"in_transit", "metadata":{ "kind":"structured", "value":{ "weight":12.5, "dims": new Uint8Array([10,20,30]) } } }
```
Observed server error:
```
400 schema_validation_error: metadata.value.dims expected number[] got string
at /tooling/runtime/handler
```
alice.support: They run ts-sdk@1.4.3 (browser bundle). ~15% tool calls fail and auto-retry twice -> extra billed tokens + latency spikes.
zhen.qa: I repro in node + webpacked browser. The browser serializer encodes TypedArray to base64 string for nested union branch; schema expects number[]. Top-level byte fields use base64 correctly but nested union path picks wrong encoding.
jonah.eng: Py SDK converts TypedArray->number[] for number[] schema; TS path currently prefers base64 for ArrayBuffer-like objects. For nested unions we lose the expectedSchema check so it chooses bytes-path.
liza.ml: Does this mis-encode ever cause wrong tool selection or only validation rejects?
alice.support: Only validation rejects right now; requests are rejected pre-tool invocation. Retries cause multiple validation attempts and duplicate billing entries.
carla.support: Paste actual proxy-observed payload + repro steps.
alice.support: Wire payload captured by proxy:
```
{"shipment_id":"sh_123","status":"in_transit","metadata":{"kind":"structured","value":{"weight":12.5,"dims":"AQoN"}}}
```
So dims became base64 string "AQoN".

Customer repro (browser):
1) const dims = new Uint8Array([10,20,30]);
2) client.tool.call('shipment.update', { shipment_id, status, metadata: { kind: 'structured', value: { weight: 12.5, dims } } })
3) See 400 schema_validation_error.

Quick node repro:
```
// repro.js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const dims = Buffer.from([10,20,30]);
await client.tool.call('shipment.update', { shipment_id:'sh_123', status:'in_transit', metadata:{ kind:'structured', value:{ weight:12.5, dims } } });
```

logs:
[2026-03-15T14:14:12Z] incoming: /toolcall shipment.update from sdk.ts (browser bundle)
[2026-03-15T14:14:12Z] validation: metadata.value.dims type mismatch: expected number[] got string

jonah.eng: Theory: serializer inspects typed arrays and picks base64 encoding when schema not checked deeply for nested unions. Fix: when expectedSchema is array of numbers and value is TypedArray, convert to Array.from(v). Patch:
```
if (expectedSchema?.type === 'array' && expectedSchema.items?.type === 'number' && isTypedArray(v)) {
  return Array.from(v);
}
```
Also only treat strings-as-base64 if schema expects bytes.

jonah.eng: I'll open a PR for ts-sdk release branch and publish 1.4.4-rc today.
zhen.qa: Adding interop tests across py/ts/go to CI: tests/interop/nested-union-byte.spec.ts. I'll include browser-bundle test.
carla.support: Does Go SDK behave similarly?
jonah.eng: Go already maps []byte -> []int properly in our examples, but we'll run the regression.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-15-37 created. SLA 8h. Assigned eng-runtime.
carla.support: Assigned to @jonah.eng and @zhen.qa. Priority P1.
alice.support: Workaround suggested to customer: convert TypedArray to Array before calling. Example:
```
const dimsArray = Array.from(dims);
client.tool.call('shipment.update', { metadata: { kind:'structured', value:{ weight:12.5, dims: dimsArray } } });
```
alice.support: I'll collect billing delta for Parcelly and propose credit if retries > 3 billed. Will update thread.
liza.ml: Please keep timeline and metrics for finance. Thanks :heart:
